ko.title: [농업 101 #7] 잔디를 깎은 후에 옆으로 자라는 이유: 식물 생장의 화학

segments.src: > Plants build their bodies from sunlight and air, then decide where to put that material using a handful of chemical signals — and farmers have learned to send those signals themselves.
segments.tr: > 식물은 햇빛과 공기로 몸을 만든 후, 소수의 화학적 신호를 사용하여 그 물질을 어디에 둘지 결정합니다. 그리고 농부들은 그 신호를 직접 보내는 법을 배웠습니다.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 오늘의 개념

segments.src: A corn plant standing seven feet tall in an Iowa field is made mostly of air and water.
segments.tr: 아이오와주의 들판에 7피트 높이로 서 있는 옥수수 한 그루는 대부분 공기와 물로 이루어져 있습니다.

segments.src: That sounds like a trick, but it's literal.
segments.tr: 말장난 같지만 말 그대로 사실입니다.

segments.src: Through **photosynthesis**, leaves pull carbon dioxide out of the atmosphere, split water pulled up from the roots, and use light energy to weld the pieces into sugar.
segments.tr: **광합성**을 통해 잎은 대기 중에서 이산화탄소를 끌어내고, 뿌리에서 끌어올린 물을 쪼개며, 빛 에너지를 이용하여 이 조각들을 당으로 결합합니다.

segments.src: The soil contributes minerals — nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium — but the bulk of the dry weight came in through tiny pores on the leaf surface called stomata.
segments.tr: 토양은 질소, 인, 칼륨 같은 미네랄을 공급하지만, 건조 중량의 대부분은 기공이라고 불리는 잎 표면의 미세한 구멍을 통해 들어왔습니다.

segments.src: You can write the whole thing in one line:
segments.tr: 이 모든 과정을 한 줄로 쓸 수 있습니다:

segments.src: 6 CO2 + 6 H2O + light energy -> C6H12O6 (sugar) + 6 O2
segments.tr: 6 CO2 + 6 H2O + light energy -> C6H12O6 (sugar) + 6 O2

segments.src: That's the **growth** half of the story: accumulating material.
segments.tr: 이것이 이야기의 **생장** 절반, 즉 물질 축적에 해당합니다.

segments.src: But a pile of sugar isn't a plant.
segments.tr: 하지만 설탕 더미가 곧 식물은 아닙니다.

segments.src: The other half is **development** — deciding what to become and when.
segments.tr: 나머지 절반은 **발달**로, 무엇이 될지 그리고 언제 될지를 결정하는 것입니다.

segments.src: A seedling has to choose whether to make more leaves or start a flower, whether to grow tall or grow thick, whether to hold its fruit or drop it.
segments.tr: 어린 묘목은 잎을 더 만들 것인지 꽃을 피울 것인지, 키가 크게 자랄 것인지 굵게 자랄 것인지, 열매를 매달아 둘 것인지 떨어뜨릴 것인지 선택해야 합니다.

segments.src: Those decisions are coordinated by **plant hormones**, chemical messengers made in tiny quantities that travel through the plant's tissues.
segments.tr: 이러한 결정은 식물의 조직을 통해 이동하는 미량의 화학적 메신저인 **식물 호르몬**에 의해 조율됩니다.

segments.src: Five families do most of the work:
segments.tr: 다섯 가지 계열이 대부분의 역할을 담당합니다:

segments.src: - **Auxin** drives cell elongation and, critically, enforces *apical dominance* — the growing tip suppresses the buds below it, which is why an unpruned plant grows as a single leader.
segments.tr: - **옥신(Auxin)**은 세포 신장을 유도하며, 결정적으로 *정단 우세성(apical dominance)*을 발휘합니다. 즉, 자라나는 끝부분이 아래쪽의 눈들을 억제하며, 이것이 가지치기를 하지 않은 식물이 하나의 주줄기로 자라는 이유입니다.

segments.src: - **Gibberellin** stretches stems and internodes, and triggers seed germination.
segments.tr: - **지베렐린(Gibberellin)**은 줄기와 마디를 늘려주고 종자 발아를 촉진합니다.

segments.src: - **Cytokinin** promotes cell division and pushes side buds to break out — essentially auxin's counterweight.
segments.tr: - **사이토키닌(Cytokinin)**은 세포 분열을 촉진하고 옆눈이 트이도록 밀어냅니다. 본질적으로 옥신의 평형추 역할을 합니다.

segments.src: - **Abscisic acid (ABA)** is the stress brake. Under drought it closes stomata and enforces seed dormancy.
segments.tr: - **앱시스산(Abscisic acid, ABA)**은 스트레스 브레이크입니다. 가뭄 시 기공을 닫고 종자 휴眠을 유도합니다.

segments.src: - **Ethylene** is a gas, and it drives ripening and the shedding of leaves and fruit.
segments.tr: - **에틸렌(Ethylene)**은 가스이며, 숙성과 잎 및 열매의 탈락을 유도합니다.

segments.src: The important insight is that these hormones rarely act alone.
segments.tr: 중요한 통찰은 이러한 호르몬들이 결코 혼자 작용하지 않는다는 점입니다.

segments.src: It's the *ratio* between them that matters.
segments.tr: 중요한 것은 그들 사이의 *비율*입니다.

segments.src: High auxin relative to cytokinin favors roots; flip the ratio and you get shoots.
segments.tr: 사이토키닌에 비해 옥신이 많으면 뿌리에 유리하고, 비율을 뒤집으면 새순이 자랍니다.

segments.src: Tissue culture labs exploit this directly: change the ratio in the growth medium and the same clump of cells becomes either a root mass or a leafy shoot.
segments.tr: 조직 배양실은 이를 직접 활용합니다. 생장 배지의 비율을 바꾸면 동일한 세포 덩어리가 뿌리 덩어리가 되거나 잎이 우거진 새순이 됩니다.

segments.src: Once researchers understood the signals, the next step was obvious — send them on purpose.
segments.tr: 연구자들이 신호를 이해하게 된 후, 다음 단계는 당연히 의도적으로 신호를 보내는 것이었습니다.

segments.src: **Plant growth regulators (PGRs)** are synthetic or extracted compounds that mimic or block natural hormones.
segments.tr: **식물 생장 조절제(PGR)**는 천연 호르몬을 모방하거나 차단하는 합성 또는 추출 화합물입니다.

segments.src: Ethylene-releasing sprays ripen a tomato crop uniformly for machine harvest.
segments.tr: 에틸렌 방출 스프레이는 기계 수확을 위해 토마토 작물을 균일하게 익힙니다.

segments.src: Gibberellin applied to table grapes stretches the cluster so berries have room to swell.
segments.tr: 식용 포도에 적용된 지베렐린은 송이를 늘려 베리가 팽창할 공간을 제공합니다.

segments.src: Anti-gibberellins shorten wheat straw so the stalk doesn't fall over — lodging — under the weight of a heavy head.
segments.tr: 안티 지베렐린은 밀짚을 짧게 만들어 무거운 이삭의 무게로 인해 줄기가 쓰러지는 현상인 *도복*을 방지합니다.

segments.src: And the herbicide 2,4-D is essentially a synthetic auxin at a dose so high that broadleaf weeds grow themselves to death while grasses shrug it off.
segments.tr: 그리고 제초제 2,4-D는 본질적으로 매우 고용량의 합성 옥신으로, 광엽 잡초는 스스로 자라다 죽게 만들고 잔디는 이를 무시합니다.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 일상생활 속에서

segments.src: Walk into any American grocery store in February and look at the bananas.
segments.tr: 2월에 미국의 아무 식료품점에나 들어가 바나나를 살펴보세요.

segments.src: They're green-tipped and firm — because they were picked green in Guatemala or Ecuador, shipped in refrigerated containers, and then held in a sealed ripening room where the distributor pumps in ethylene gas.
segments.tr: 과테말라나 에콰도르에서 초록색 상태로 수확되어 냉장 컨테이너로 배송된 후, 유통업체가 에틸렌 가스를 주입하는 밀폐된 숙성실에 보관되었기 때문에 끝부분이 초록색이고 단단합니다.

segments.src: A day or two later they come out yellow and ready for the shelf.
segments.tr: 하루이틀 지나면 노랗게 변해 매대에 진열될 준비가 됩니다.

segments.src: The fruit ripens on a schedule the retailer sets, not the tree.
segments.tr: 과일은 나무가 아니라 소매업자가 설정한 일정에 따라 익습니다.

segments.src: The same chemistry is why the old advice about putting an unripe avocado in a paper bag with a banana actually works.
segments.tr: 익지 않은 아보카도를 바나나와 함께 종이 봉지에 넣으면 실제로 익는다는 오랜 조언도 같은 화학적 원리 때문입니다.

segments.src: Ripening fruit emits ethylene; the bag traps it; the avocado's own ripening enzymes get switched on early.
segments.tr: 익어가는 과일은 에틸렌을 방출하고, 봉지가 이를 가두며, 아보카도 자체의 숙성 효소가 일찍 켜집니다.

segments.src: It's a two-dollar version of a commercial ripening room.
segments.tr: 상업용 숙성실의 2달러짜리 버전인 셈입니다.

segments.src: And the reverse trick shows up in your produce drawer.
segments.tr: 그리고 그 반대의 요령도 채소 서랍에서 나타납니다.

segments.src: Apples are heavy ethylene emitters, which is why storing them next to lettuce or broccoli makes those greens yellow and go limp faster than they should.
segments.tr: 사과는 에틸렌을 많이 방출하는 과일이므로 상추나 브로콜리 옆에 보관하면 그 채소들이 예상보다 빨리 노랗게 변하고 흐물흐물해집니다.

segments.src: Commercial apple storage in Washington State runs on **controlled atmosphere** rooms — oxygen dropped to roughly 1 to 3 percent, carbon dioxide raised, temperature just above freezing — which slows respiration and ethylene response enough to keep an apple sellable for months.
segments.tr: 워싱턴주의 상업용 사과 저장고는 **제어 분위기(controlled atmosphere)** 실에서 운영됩니다. 산소를 약 1~3퍼센트로 낮추고, 이산화탄소를 높이며, 온도를 빙점 바로 위로 유지함으로써 호흡과 에틸렌 반응을 늦추어 사과를 몇 달 동안 판매 가능한 상태로 유지합니다.

segments.src: That's how you buy a crisp Honeycrisp in June from an October harvest.
segments.tr: 10월 수확한 아삭한 허니크리스프를 6월에 구입할 수 있는 비결이 바로 이것입니다.

segments.src: Even your lawn is a hormone lesson.
segments.tr: 잔디밭조차도 호르몬 수업입니다.

segments.src: Mowing decapitates the auxin-producing tips, apical dominance releases, and the grass responds by branching out from the base into new tillers.
segments.tr: 잔디를 깎으면 옥신을 생성하는 끝부분이 잘려나가고 정단 우세성이 해제되며, 잔디는 밑부분에서 새로운 분얼경으로 가지를 치며 반응합니다.

segments.src: Mowing doesn't just shorten grass — it makes it denser.
segments.tr: 잔디를 깎는 것은 단순히 잔디를 짧게 만드는 것이 아니라 더 빽빽하게 만듭니다.

segments.src: Same reason pinching back a basil plant on your windowsill gives you a bushy plant instead of a single leggy stem.
segments.tr: 창틀의 바질 식물 끝을 잘라내면 줄기 하나만 뻗어 나오는 대신 덤불 같은 식물이 되는 것과 같은 이유입니다.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## 세 줄 요약

segments.src: 1. Photosynthesis supplies the raw material for growth — plants build most of their mass from atmospheric CO2 and water, not from soil.
segments.tr: 1. 광합성은 생장을 위한 원료를 공급합니다. 식물은 질량이 토양이 아니라 대기 중의 CO2와 물로부터 대부분 만들어집니다.

segments.src: 2. Development is directed by hormones (auxin, gibberellin, cytokinin, ABA, ethylene), and it's usually the ratio between them, not any single one, that determines the outcome.
segments.tr: 2. 발달은 호르몬(옥신, 지베렐린, 사이토키닌, ABA, 에틸렌)에 의해 지시되며, 결과를 결정하는 것은 단일 호르몬이 아니라 대개 그들 사이의 비율입니다.

segments.src: 3. Plant growth regulators let growers send those signals deliberately — to ripen fruit on schedule, shorten stems against lodging, size up produce, or kill weeds.
segments.tr: 3. 식물 생장 조절제를 통해 재배자들은 일정에 맞춰 과일을 익히거나, 도복에 대비해 줄기를 짧게 만들거나, 농산물의 크기를 키우거나, 잡초를 죽이기 위해 이러한 신호를 의도적으로 보낼 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 오늘의 용어

segments.src: - **Photosynthesis** — The process by which plants use light energy to convert carbon dioxide and water into sugar, releasing oxygen.
segments.tr: - **Photosynthesis (광합성)** — 식물이 빛 에너지를 이용하여 이산화탄소와 물을 당으로 변환하고 산소를 방출하는 과정.

segments.src: - **Auxin** — A hormone that drives cell elongation and causes the growing tip to suppress the buds below it.
segments.tr: - **Auxin (옥신)** — 세포 신장을 유도하고 자라나는 끝부분이 아래쪽의 눈을 억제하게 만드는 호르몬.

segments.src: - **Apical dominance** — The suppression of side buds by the actively growing shoot tip, which produces a single-leader growth habit.
segments.tr: - **Apical dominance (정단 우세성)** — 활발히 자라나는 새순 끝부분에 의한 옆눈의 억제 현상으로, 단일 주줄기 생장 습성을 만들어냄.

segments.src: - **Ethylene** — A gaseous hormone that triggers fruit ripening and the shedding of leaves and fruit.
segments.tr: - **Ethylene (에틸렌)** — 과일의 숙성과 잎 및 열매의 탈락을 유발하는 기체 상태의 호르몬.

segments.src: - **Plant growth regulator (PGR)** — A synthetic or extracted compound applied to crops to mimic or block a natural plant hormone.
segments.tr: - **Plant growth regulator (PGR, 식물 생장 조절제)** — 천연 식물 호르몬을 모방하거나 차단하기 위해 작물에 처리하는 합성 또는 추출 화합물.

segments.src: - **Lodging** — The permanent collapse of a crop stem, usually from wind, rain, or a top-heavy seed head.
segments.tr: - **Lodging (도복)** — 주로 바람, 비 또는 상부가 무거운 이삭으로 인해 작물 줄기가 영구적으로 쓰러지는 현상.

segments.src: *Answers: 1-B (soil minerals matter enormously for plant health, but they're a small fraction of dry weight; the carbon backbone comes from atmospheric CO2 and the hydrogen from water).
segments.tr: *정답: 1-B (토양 미네랄은 식물 건강에 엄청나게 중요하지만 건조 중량의 작은 부분에 불과하며, 탄소 뼈대는 대기 중의 CO2에서, 수소는 물에서 옵니다).

segments.src: 2-C (the tip is the auxin factory; remove it and the lateral buds are freed to grow — the same mechanism that makes mowing thicken a lawn).
segments.tr: 2-C (끝부분이 옥신 공장이며, 이를 제거하면 측아가 자랄 수 있게 해방됩니다. 잔디를 깎으면 잔디가 빽빽해지는 것과 같은 메커니즘입니다).

segments.src: 3-O (ethylene is the one plant hormone that's a gas at room temperature, which is exactly what makes it practical to apply in a sealed ripening room).*
segments.tr: 3-O (에틸렌은 상온에서 기체 상태인 유일한 식물 호르몬이며, 이것이 정확히 밀폐된 숙성실에서 실용적으로 적용할 수 있는 이유입니다).*

zh.title: [农业 101 #7] 为什么割草后草坪会横向生长：植物生长的化学原理

segments.src: > Plants build their bodies from sunlight and air, then decide where to put that material using a handful of chemical signals — and farmers have learned to send those signals themselves.
segments.tr: > 植物利用阳光和空气构建自身，然后利用少量的化学信号来决定这些物质的去向——而农民们已经学会了亲自发送这些信号。

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 今日概念

segments.src: A corn plant standing seven feet tall in an Iowa field is made mostly of air and water.
segments.tr: 爱荷华州田野里一株七英尺高的玉米，其主要成分是空气和水。

segments.src: That sounds like a trick, but it's literal.
segments.tr: 这听起来像个魔术，但却是事实。

segments.src: Through **photosynthesis**, leaves pull carbon dioxide out of the atmosphere, split water pulled up from the roots, and use light energy to weld the pieces into sugar.
segments.tr: 通过**光合作用**，叶片从大气中吸收二氧化碳，分解从根部吸收的水分，并利用光能将这些成分合成为糖。

segments.src: The soil contributes minerals — nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium — but the bulk of the dry weight came in through tiny pores on the leaf surface called stomata.
segments.tr: 土壤提供了矿物质——氮、磷、钾——但大部分干重是通过叶片表面被称为气孔的微小孔隙进入的。

segments.src: You can write the whole thing in one line:
segments.tr: 你可以用一行字概括整个过程：

segments.src: 6 CO2 + 6 H2O + light energy -> C6H12O6 (sugar) + 6 O2
segments.tr: 6 CO2 + 6 H2O + light energy -> C6H12O6 (sugar) + 6 O2

segments.src: That's the **growth** half of the story: accumulating material.
segments.tr: 这就是故事中关于**生长**的一半：积累物质。

segments.src: But a pile of sugar isn't a plant.
segments.tr: 但一堆糖并不等于一株植物。

segments.src: The other half is **development** — deciding what to become and when.
segments.tr: 另一半是**发育**——决定成为什么以及何时成为。

segments.src: A seedling has to choose whether to make more leaves or start a flower, whether to grow tall or grow thick, whether to hold its fruit or drop it.
segments.tr: 幼苗必须选择是长出更多的叶子还是开始开花，是长高还是长粗，是保留果实还是让其脱落。

segments.src: Those decisions are coordinated by **plant hormones**, chemical messengers made in tiny quantities that travel through the plant's tissues.
segments.tr: 这些决定由**植物激素**协调，它们是微量产生的化学信使，在植物组织中传递。

segments.src: Five families do most of the work:
segments.tr: 五个家族承担了大部分工作：

segments.src: - **Auxin** drives cell elongation and, critically, enforces *apical dominance* — the growing tip suppresses the buds below it, which is why an unpruned plant grows as a single leader.
segments.tr: - **生长素 (Auxin)** 驱动细胞伸长，且至关重要的是，它维持*顶端优势*——生长尖端抑制下方的芽，这就是为什么未经修剪的植物会作为单一主茎生长。

segments.src: - **Gibberellin** stretches stems and internodes, and triggers seed germination.
segments.tr: - **赤霉素 (Gibberellin)** 拉伸茎和节间，并触发种子萌发。

segments.src: - **Cytokinin** promotes cell division and pushes side buds to break out — essentially auxin's counterweight.
segments.tr: - **细胞分裂素 (Cytokinin)** 促进细胞分裂并推动侧芽萌发——本质上是生长素的平衡物。

segments.src: - **Abscisic acid (ABA)** is the stress brake. Under drought it closes stomata and enforces seed dormancy.
segments.tr: - **脱落酸 (ABA)** 是压力刹车。在干旱条件下，它会关闭气孔并强制种子休眠。

segments.src: - **Ethylene** is a gas, and it drives ripening and the shedding of leaves and fruit.
segments.tr: - **乙烯 (Ethylene)** 是一种气体，它驱动果实成熟以及叶片和果实的脱落。

segments.src: The important insight is that these hormones rarely act alone.
segments.tr: 重要的见解是，这些激素很少单独起作用。

segments.src: It's the *ratio* between them that matters.
segments.tr: 重要的是它们之间的*比例*。

segments.src: High auxin relative to cytokinin favors roots; flip the ratio and you get shoots.
segments.tr: 相对于细胞分裂素，高浓度的生长素有利于根系生长；反之，改变比例则会促进枝条生长。

segments.src: Tissue culture labs exploit this directly: change the ratio in the growth medium and the same clump of cells becomes either a root mass or a leafy shoot.
segments.tr: 组织培养实验室直接利用了这一点：改变生长培养基中的比例，同一团细胞就会变成根系或叶状枝条。

segments.src: Once researchers understood the signals, the next step was obvious — send them on purpose.
segments.tr: 一旦研究人员理解了这些信号，下一步就很明显了——有目的地发送它们。

segments.src: **Plant growth regulators (PGRs)** are synthetic or extracted compounds that mimic or block natural hormones.
segments.tr: **植物生长调节剂 (PGRs)** 是模拟或阻断天然激素的合成或提取化合物。

segments.src: Ethylene-releasing sprays ripen a tomato crop uniformly for machine harvest.
segments.tr: 释放乙烯的喷雾剂可以使番茄作物均匀成熟，以便机器采收。

segments.src: Gibberellin applied to table grapes stretches the cluster so berries have room to swell.
segments.tr: 施用于鲜食葡萄的赤霉素可以拉伸果穗，让浆果有膨胀的空间。

segments.src: Anti-gibberellins shorten wheat straw so the stalk doesn't fall over — lodging — under the weight of a heavy head.
segments.tr: 抗赤霉素可以缩短小麦秸秆，这样茎秆就不会因为沉重的穗头重量而倒伏。

segments.src: And the herbicide 2,4-D is essentially a synthetic auxin at a dose so high that broadleaf weeds grow themselves to death while grasses shrug it off.
segments.tr: 而除草剂 2,4-D 本质上是一种高剂量的合成生长素，阔叶杂草会因过度生长而死亡，而禾本科植物则不受影响。

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 日常生活中的应用

segments.src: Walk into any American grocery store in February and look at the bananas.
segments.tr: 二月份走进任何一家美国杂货店，看看香蕉。

segments.src: They're green-tipped and firm — because they were picked green in Guatemala or Ecuador, shipped in refrigerated containers, and then held in a sealed ripening room where the distributor pumps in ethylene gas.
segments.tr: 它们尖端发绿且坚硬——因为它们在危地马拉或厄瓜多尔被青色采摘，用冷藏集装箱运输，然后存放在密封的催熟室中，由分销商注入乙烯气体。

segments.src: A day or two later they come out yellow and ready for the shelf.
segments.tr: 一两天后，它们变黄并准备上架。

segments.src: The fruit ripens on a schedule the retailer sets, not the tree.
segments.tr: 水果成熟的时间表是由零售商设定的，而不是由树决定的。

segments.src: The same chemistry is why the old advice about putting an unripe avocado in a paper bag with a banana actually works.
segments.tr: 同样的化学原理也解释了为什么关于把未成熟的牛油果和香蕉放在纸袋里的老建议确实有效。

segments.src: Ripening fruit emits ethylene; the bag traps it; the avocado's own ripening enzymes get switched on early.
segments.tr: 成熟的水果会释放乙烯；纸袋将其困住；牛油果自身的成熟酶被提前激活。

segments.src: It's a two-dollar version of a commercial ripening room.
segments.tr: 这简直是商业催熟室的两美元版本。

segments.src: And the reverse trick shows up in your produce drawer.
segments.tr: 反向的技巧也出现在你的蔬果抽屉里。

segments.src: Apples are heavy ethylene emitters, which is why storing them next to lettuce or broccoli makes those greens yellow and go limp faster than they should.
segments.tr: 苹果是强乙烯释放源，这就是为什么把它们和生菜或西兰花放在一起会导致这些绿叶蔬菜比预期更快变黄和变软。

segments.src: Commercial apple storage in Washington State runs on **controlled atmosphere** rooms — oxygen dropped to roughly 1 to 3 percent, carbon dioxide raised, temperature just above freezing — which slows respiration and ethylene response enough to keep an apple sellable for months.
segments.tr: 华盛顿州的商业苹果储存采用**气调**室——氧气降至约 1% 到 3%，二氧化碳升高，温度保持在冰点以上——这减缓了呼吸作用和乙烯反应，足以让苹果保持数月的可售状态。

segments.src: That's how you buy a crisp Honeycrisp in June from an October harvest.
segments.tr: 这就是你如何在六月份买到十月份收获的脆甜 Honeycrisp 苹果的原因。

segments.src: Even your lawn is a hormone lesson.
segments.tr: 即使是你的草坪也是一堂激素课。

segments.src: Mowing decapitates the auxin-producing tips, apical dominance releases, and the grass responds by branching out from the base into new tillers.
segments.tr: 割草切掉了产生生长素的尖端，顶端优势解除，草坪通过从基部萌发新分蘖来做出反应。

segments.src: Mowing doesn't just shorten grass — it makes it denser.
segments.tr: 割草不仅仅是缩短草的高度——它让草坪更茂密。

segments.src: Same reason pinching back a basil plant on your windowsill gives you a bushy plant instead of a single leggy stem.
segments.tr: 同样的原因，掐掉窗台上罗勒植物的顶端，会让你得到一株茂密的植物，而不是一根细长的茎。

segments.src: ## Three-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## 三行总结

segments.src: 1. Photosynthesis supplies the raw material for growth — plants build most of their mass from atmospheric CO2 and water, not from soil.
segments.tr: 1. 光合作用为生长提供了原材料——植物大部分的质量来自大气中的二氧化碳和水，而不是土壤。

segments.src: 2. Development is directed by hormones (auxin, gibberellin, cytokinin, ABA, ethylene), and it's usually the ratio between them, not any single one, that determines the outcome.
segments.tr: 2. 发育由激素（生长素、赤霉素、细胞分裂素、脱落酸、乙烯）引导，通常是它们之间的比例，而不是单一激素，决定了结果。

segments.src: 3. Plant growth regulators let growers send those signals deliberately — to ripen fruit on schedule, shorten stems against lodging, size up produce, or kill weeds.
segments.tr: 3. 植物生长调节剂让种植者能够刻意发送这些信号——从而按计划催熟水果、缩短茎秆以防倒伏、增大农产品尺寸或清除杂草。

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 今日术语

segments.src: - **Photosynthesis** — The process by which plants use light energy to convert carbon dioxide and water into sugar, releasing oxygen.
segments.tr: - **光合作用 (Photosynthesis)** — 植物利用光能将二氧化碳和水转化为糖并释放氧气的过程。

segments.src: - **Auxin** — A hormone that drives cell elongation and causes the growing tip to suppress the buds below it.
segments.tr: - **生长素 (Auxin)** — 一种驱动细胞伸长并导致生长尖端抑制下方芽的激素。

segments.src: - **Apical dominance** — The suppression of side buds by the actively growing shoot tip, which produces a single-leader growth habit.
segments.tr: - **顶端优势 (Apical dominance)** — 活跃生长的茎尖对侧芽的抑制，这产生了单一主茎的生长习性。

segments.src: - **Ethylene** — A gaseous hormone that triggers fruit ripening and the shedding of leaves and fruit.
segments.tr: - **乙烯 (Ethylene)** — 一种触发果实成熟以及叶片和果实脱落的气态激素。

segments.src: - **Plant growth regulator (PGR)** — A synthetic or extracted compound applied to crops to mimic or block a natural plant hormone.
segments.tr: - **植物生长调节剂 (PGR)** — 施用于作物以模拟或阻断天然植物激素的合成或提取化合物。

segments.src: - **Lodging** — The permanent collapse of a crop stem, usually from wind, rain, or a top-heavy seed head.
segments.tr: - **倒伏 (Lodging)** — 作物茎秆的永久性倒塌，通常由风、雨或头重脚轻的穗头引起。

segments.src: *Answers: 1-B (soil minerals matter enormously for plant health, but they're a small fraction of dry weight; the carbon backbone comes from atmospheric CO2 and the hydrogen from water).
segments.tr: *答案：1-B（土壤矿物质对植物健康至关重要，但它们只占干重的一小部分；碳骨架来自大气中的二氧化碳，氢来自水）。

segments.src: 2-C (the tip is the auxin factory; remove it and the lateral buds are freed to grow — the same mechanism that makes mowing thicken a lawn).
segments.tr: 2-C（尖端是生长素工厂；移除它，侧芽就被释放出来生长——这与割草使草坪变厚的机制相同）。

segments.src: 3-O (ethylene is the one plant hormone that's a gas at room temperature, which is exactly what makes it practical to apply in a sealed ripening room).*
segments.tr: 3-对（乙烯是唯一在室温下为气体的植物激素，这正是使其在密封催熟室中应用变得实用的原因）。*

es.title: [Agricultura 101 #7] Por qué tu césped crece de lado después de cortarlo: La química del crecimiento de las plantas

segments.src: > Plants build their bodies from sunlight and air, then decide where to put that material using a handful of chemical signals — and farmers have learned to send those signals themselves.
segments.tr: > Las plantas construyen sus cuerpos a partir de la luz solar y el aire, y luego deciden dónde colocar ese material utilizando un puñado de señales químicas; y los agricultores han aprendido a enviar esas señales ellos mismos.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Concepto de hoy

segments.src: A corn plant standing seven feet tall in an Iowa field is made mostly of air and water.
segments.tr: Una planta de maíz de siete pies de altura en un campo de Iowa está hecha principalmente de aire y agua.

segments.src: That sounds like a trick, but it's literal.
segments.tr: Eso suena a truco, pero es literal.

segments.src: Through **photosynthesis**, leaves pull carbon dioxide out of the atmosphere, split water pulled up from the roots, and use light energy to weld the pieces into sugar.
segments.tr: A través de la **fotosíntesis**, las hojas extraen dióxido de carbono de la atmósfera, dividen el agua absorbida por las raíces y utilizan la energía lumínica para soldar las piezas en azúcar.

segments.src: The soil contributes minerals — nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium — but the bulk of the dry weight came in through tiny pores on the leaf surface called stomata.
segments.tr: El suelo aporta minerales (nitrógeno, fósforo, potasio), pero la mayor parte del peso seco entró a través de diminutos poros en la superficie de la hoja llamados estomas.

segments.src: You can write the whole thing in one line:
segments.tr: Puedes escribir todo el proceso en una sola línea:

segments.src: 6 CO2 + 6 H2O + light energy -> C6H12O6 (sugar) + 6 O2
segments.tr: 6 CO2 + 6 H2O + light energy -> C6H12O6 (sugar) + 6 O2

segments.src: That's the **growth** half of the story: accumulating material.
segments.tr: Esa es la mitad del **crecimiento** de la historia: acumular material.

segments.src: But a pile of sugar isn't a plant.
segments.tr: Pero un montón de azúcar no es una planta.

segments.src: The other half is **development** — deciding what to become and when.
segments.tr: La otra mitad es el **desarrollo**: decidir en qué convertirse y cuándo.

segments.src: A seedling has to choose whether to make more leaves or start a flower, whether to grow tall or grow thick, whether to hold its fruit or drop it.
segments.tr: Una plántula tiene que elegir si producir más hojas o comenzar a florecer, si crecer alta o gruesa, si retener su fruto o dejarlo caer.

segments.src: Those decisions are coordinated by **plant hormones**, chemical messengers made in tiny quantities that travel through the plant's tissues.
segments.tr: Esas decisiones están coordinadas por **hormonas vegetales**, mensajeros químicos producidos en cantidades diminutas que viajan a través de los tejidos de la planta.

segments.src: Five families do most of the work:
segments.tr: Cinco familias hacen la mayor parte del trabajo:

segments.src: - **Auxin** drives cell elongation and, critically, enforces *apical dominance* — the growing tip suppresses the buds below it, which is why an unpruned plant grows as a single leader.
segments.tr: - La **auxina** impulsa la elongación celular y, fundamentalmente, impone la *dominancia apical*: el brote en crecimiento suprime las yemas debajo de él, razón por la cual una planta sin podar crece como un solo tallo principal.

segments.src: - **Gibberellin** stretches stems and internodes, and triggers seed germination.
segments.tr: - La **giberelina** estira los tallos y los entrenudos, y desencadena la germinación de las semillas.

segments.src: - **Cytokinin** promotes cell division and pushes side buds to break out — essentially auxin's counterweight.
segments.tr: - La **citoquinina** promueve la división celular y empuja a las yemas laterales a brotar; es esencialmente el contrapeso de la auxina.

segments.src: - **Abscisic acid (ABA)** is the stress brake. Under drought it closes stomata and enforces seed dormancy.
segments.tr: - El **ácido abscísico (ABA)** es el freno de estrés. Durante la sequía, cierra los estomas e impone la latencia de las semillas.

segments.src: - **Ethylene** is a gas, and it drives ripening and the shedding of leaves and fruit.
segments.tr: - El **etileno** es un gas que impulsa la maduración y la caída de hojas y frutos.

segments.src: The important insight is that these hormones rarely act alone.
segments.tr: La idea importante es que estas hormonas rara vez actúan solas.

segments.src: It's the *ratio* between them that matters.
segments.tr: Lo que importa es la *proporción* entre ellas.

segments.src: High auxin relative to cytokinin favors roots; flip the ratio and you get shoots.
segments.tr: Una alta concentración de auxina en relación con la citoquinina favorece las raíces; invierte la proporción y obtendrás brotes.

segments.src: Tissue culture labs exploit this directly: change the ratio in the growth medium and the same clump of cells becomes either a root mass or a leafy shoot.
segments.tr: Los laboratorios de cultivo de tejidos explotan esto directamente: cambian la proporción en el medio de cultivo y el mismo grupo de células se convierte en una masa de raíces o en un brote frondoso.

segments.src: Once researchers understood the signals, the next step was obvious — send them on purpose.
segments.tr: Una vez que los investigadores entendieron las señales, el siguiente paso fue obvio: enviarlas a propósito.

segments.src: **Plant growth regulators (PGRs)** are synthetic or extracted compounds that mimic or block natural hormones.
segments.tr: Los **reguladores del crecimiento vegetal (PGR, por sus siglas en inglés)** son compuestos sintéticos o extraídos que imitan o bloquean las hormonas naturales.

segments.src: Ethylene-releasing sprays ripen a tomato crop uniformly for machine harvest.
segments.tr: Los aerosoles que liberan etileno maduran una cosecha de tomates de manera uniforme para la cosecha mecánica.

segments.src: Gibberellin applied to table grapes stretches the cluster so berries have room to swell.
segments.tr: La giberelina aplicada a las uvas de mesa estira el racimo para que las bayas tengan espacio para hincharse.

segments.src: Anti-gibberellins shorten wheat straw so the stalk doesn't fall over — lodging — under the weight of a heavy head.
segments.tr: Los antigiberelínicos acortan la paja del trigo para que el tallo no se caiga (encamado) bajo el peso de una espiga pesada.

segments.src: And the herbicide 2,4-D is essentially a synthetic auxin at a dose so high that broadleaf weeds grow themselves to death while grasses shrug it off.
segments.tr: Y el herbicida 2,4-D es esencialmente una auxina sintética en una dosis tan alta que las malezas de hoja ancha crecen hasta morir mientras que las gramíneas lo ignoran.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## En la vida cotidiana

segments.src: Walk into any American grocery store in February and look at the bananas.
segments.tr: Entra en cualquier supermercado estadounidense en febrero y mira los plátanos.

segments.src: They're green-tipped and firm — because they were picked green in Guatemala or Ecuador, shipped in refrigerated containers, and then held in a sealed ripening room where the distributor pumps in ethylene gas.
segments.tr: Tienen las puntas verdes y están firmes, porque fueron cosechados verdes en Guatemala o Ecuador, enviados en contenedores refrigerados y luego mantenidos en una sala de maduración sellada donde el distribuidor bombea gas etileno.

segments.src: A day or two later they come out yellow and ready for the shelf.
segments.tr: Un día o dos después salen amarillos y listos para el estante.

segments.src: The fruit ripens on a schedule the retailer sets, not the tree.
segments.tr: La fruta madura según un calendario que establece el minorista, no el árbol.

segments.src: The same chemistry is why the old advice about putting an unripe avocado in a paper bag with a banana actually works.
segments.tr: La misma química es la razón por la que el viejo consejo de poner un aguacate verde en una bolsa de papel con un plátano realmente funciona.

segments.src: Ripening fruit emits ethylene; the bag traps it; the avocado's own ripening enzymes get switched on early.
segments.tr: La fruta que madura emite etileno; la bolsa lo atrapa; las propias enzimas de maduración del aguacate se activan antes de tiempo.

segments.src: It's a two-dollar version of a commercial ripening room.
segments.tr: Es una versión de dos dólares de una sala de maduración comercial.

segments.src: And the reverse trick shows up in your produce drawer.
segments.tr: Y el truco inverso aparece en tu cajón de verduras.

segments.src: Apples are heavy ethylene emitters, which is why storing them next to lettuce or broccoli makes those greens yellow and go limp faster than they should.
segments.tr: Las manzanas son grandes emisoras de etileno, por lo que almacenarlas junto a la lechuga o el brócoli hace que esas verduras se pongan amarillas y se marchiten más rápido de lo que deberían.

segments.src: Commercial apple storage in Washington State runs on **controlled atmosphere** rooms — oxygen dropped to roughly 1 to 3 percent, carbon dioxide raised, temperature just above freezing — which slows respiration and ethylene response enough to keep an apple sellable for months.
segments.tr: El almacenamiento comercial de manzanas en el estado de Washington funciona en salas de **atmósfera controlada**: el oxígeno se reduce a aproximadamente entre el 1 y el 3 por ciento, se aumenta el dióxido de carbono, la temperatura se mantiene justo por encima del punto de congelación, lo que ralentiza la respiración y la respuesta al etileno lo suficiente como para mantener una manzana vendible durante meses.

segments.src: That's how you buy a crisp Honeycrisp in June from an October harvest.
segments.tr: Así es como compras una Honeycrisp crujiente en junio proveniente de una cosecha de octubre.

segments.src: Even your lawn is a hormone lesson.
segments.tr: Incluso tu césped es una lección de hormonas.

segments.src: Mowing decapitates the auxin-producing tips, apical dominance releases, and the grass responds by branching out from the base into new tillers.
segments.tr: Cortar el césped decapita las puntas productoras de auxina, la dominancia apical se libera y el césped responde ramificándose desde la base en nuevos macollos.

segments.src: Mowing doesn't just shorten grass — it makes it denser.
segments.tr: Cortar el césped no solo lo acorta, sino que lo hace más denso.

segments.src: Same reason pinching back a basil plant on your windowsill gives you a bushy plant instead of a single leggy stem.
segments.tr: Es la misma razón por la que pellizcar una planta de albahaca en el alféizar de tu ventana te da una planta tupida en lugar de un solo tallo largo y delgado.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## Resumen en tres líneas

segments.src: 1. Photosynthesis supplies the raw material for growth — plants build most of their mass from atmospheric CO2 and water, not from soil.
segments.tr: 1. La fotosíntesis suministra la materia prima para el crecimiento: las plantas construyen la mayor parte de su masa a partir del CO2 atmosférico y el agua, no del suelo.

segments.src: 2. Development is directed by hormones (auxin, gibberellin, cytokinin, ABA, ethylene), and it's usually the ratio between them, not any single one, that determines the outcome.
segments.tr: 2. El desarrollo está dirigido por hormonas (auxina, giberelina, citoquinina, ABA, etileno), y generalmente es la proporción entre ellas, no ninguna por sí sola, la que determina el resultado.

segments.src: 3. Plant growth regulators let growers send those signals deliberately — to ripen fruit on schedule, shorten stems against lodging, size up produce, or kill weeds.
segments.tr: 3. Los reguladores del crecimiento vegetal permiten a los productores enviar esas señales deliberadamente: para madurar la fruta según lo programado, acortar los tallos para evitar el encamado, aumentar el tamaño de los productos o eliminar las malezas.

segments.src: Those decisions are coordinated by **plant hormones**, chemical messengers made in tiny quantities that travel through the plant's tissues.
segments.tr: تنسيق تلك القرارات يتم بواسطة **هرمونات النبات**, وهي رسل كيميائية تصنع بكميات ضئيلة وتنتقل عبر أنسجة النبات.

segments.src: Five families do most of the work:
segments.tr: تقوم خمس عائلات بمعظم العمل:

segments.src: - **Auxin** drives cell elongation and, critically, enforces *apical dominance* — the growing tip suppresses the buds below it, which is why an unpruned plant grows as a single leader.
segments.tr: - **الأوكسين** يدفع استطالة الخلايا، والأهم من ذلك، فرض *السيادة القمية* — فالطرف النامي يثبط البراعم أدناه، وهو سبب نمو النبات غير المقلم كقائد وحيد.

segments.src: - **Gibberellin** stretches stems and internodes, and triggers seed germination.
segments.tr: - **الجبريلين** يمدد السيقان والعقد الداخلية، ويحفز إنبات البذور.

segments.src: - **Cytokinin** promotes cell division and pushes side buds to break out — essentially auxin's counterweight.
segments.tr: - **السيتوكينين** يعزز انقسام الخلايا ويدفع البراعم الجانبية للانفجار — وهو أساساً ثقل موازن للأوكسين.

segments.src: - **Abscisic acid (ABA)** is the stress brake. Under drought it closes stomata and enforces seed dormancy.
segments.tr: - **حمض الأبسيسيك (ABA)** هو فرامل الإجهاد. في ظروف الجفاف يغلق الثغور ويفرض سكون البذور.

segments.src: - **Ethylene** is a gas, and it drives ripening and the shedding of leaves and fruit.
segments.tr: - **الإيثيلين** هو غاز، وهو يدفع النضج وتفتح الأوراق والثمار.

segments.src: The important insight is that these hormones rarely act alone.
segments.tr: الرؤية المهمة هي أن هذه الهرمونات نادراً ما تعمل وحدها.

segments.src: It's the *ratio* between them that matters.
segments.tr: إنها *النسبة* بينها هي ما يهم.

segments.src: High auxin relative to cytokinin favors roots; flip the ratio and you get shoots.
segments.tr: الأوكسين العالي نسبة إلى السيتوكينين يفضل الجذور؛ اقلب النسبة وستحصل على براعم.

segments.src: Tissue culture labs exploit this directly: change the ratio in the growth medium and the same clump of cells becomes either a root mass or a leafy shoot.
segments.tr: تستغل مختبرات زراعة الأنسجة هذا مباشرة: تغيير النسبة في وسط النمو يجعل نفس كتلة الخلايا تصبح إما كتلة جذرية أو فرعاً مورقاً.

segments.src: Once researchers understood the signals, the next step was obvious — send them on purpose.
segments.tr: بمجرد أن فهم الباحثون الإشارات، كانت الخطوة التالية واضحة — إرسالها عمداً.

segments.src: **Plant growth regulators (PGRs)** are synthetic or extracted compounds that mimic or block natural hormones.
segments.tr: **منظمات نمو النبات (PGRs)** هي مركبات اصطناعية أو مستخلصة تحاكي أو تحجب الهرمونات الطبيعية.

segments.src: Ethylene-releasing sprays ripen a tomato crop uniformly for machine harvest.
segments.tr: بخاخات إطلاق الإيثيلين تنضج محصول الطماطم بشكل موحد للحصاد الآلي.

segments.src: Gibberellin applied to table grapes stretches the cluster so berries have room to swell.
segments.tr: الجبريلين المطبق على عنب المائدة يمدد العنقود حتى تتاح للثمار مساحة للتورم.

segments.src: Anti-gibberellins shorten wheat straw so the stalk doesn't fall over — lodging — under the weight of a heavy head.
segments.tr: مضادات الجبريلين تقصر قش القمح حتى لا يسقط الساق — الرقاد — تحت ثقل رأس ثقيل.

segments.src: And the herbicide 2,4-D is essentially a synthetic auxin at a dose so high that broadleaf weeds grow themselves to death while grasses shrug it off.
segments.tr: ومبيد الأعشاب 2,4-D هو أساساً أوكسين اصطناعي بجرعة عالية لدرجة أن الأعشاب ذات الأوراق العريضة تنمو حتى الموت بينما تتجاهلها الأعشاب.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## في الحياة اليومية

segments.src: Walk into any American grocery store in February and look at the bananas.
segments.tr: ادخل إلى أي متجر بقالة أمريكي في فبراير وانظر إلى الموز.

segments.src: They're green-tipped and firm — because they were picked green in Guatemala or Ecuador, shipped in refrigerated containers, and then held in a sealed ripening room where the distributor pumps in ethylene gas.
segments.tr: إنها ذات رؤوس خضراء ومتباينة — لأنها قطفت خضراء في غواتيمالا أو الإكوادور، وشحنت في حاويات مبردة، ثم حفظت في غرفة إنضاج محكمة حيث يضخ الموزع غاز الإيثيلين.

segments.src: A day or two later they come out yellow and ready for the shelf.
segments.tr: بعد يوم أو يومين تخرج صفراء وجاهزة للرفوف.

segments.src: The fruit ripens on a schedule the retailer sets, not the tree.
segments.tr: تنضج الفاكهة وفق جدول يحدده بائع التجزئة، وليس الشجرة.

segments.src: The same chemistry is why the old advice about putting an unripe avocado in a paper bag with a banana actually works.
segments.tr: نفس الكيمياء هي سبب نجاح النصيحة القديمة حول وضع أفوكادو غير ناضج في كيس ورقي مع موز.

segments.src: Ripening fruit emits ethylene; the bag traps it; the avocado's own ripening enzymes get switched on early.
segments.tr: تطلق الفاكهة الناضجة الإيثيلين؛ يحبسه الكيس؛ ويتم تشغيل إنزيمات نضج الأفوكادو الخاصة مبكراً.

segments.src: It's a two-dollar version of a commercial ripening room.
segments.tr: إنها نسخة بدولارين لغرفة إنضاج تجارية.

segments.src: And the reverse trick shows up in your produce drawer.
segments.tr: وتظهر الخדعة العكسية في درج المنتجات الخاص بك.

segments.src: Apples are heavy ethylene emitters, which is why storing them next to lettuce or broccoli makes those greens yellow and go limp faster than they should.
segments.tr: التفاح مصادر إيثيلين ثقيلة، وهو سبب تخزينه بجوار الخس أو البروكلي يجعل تلك الخضروات تصفر وتذبل أسرع مما ينبغي.

segments.src: Commercial apple storage in Washington State runs on **controlled atmosphere** rooms — oxygen dropped to roughly 1 to 3 percent, carbon dioxide raised, temperature just above freezing — which slows respiration and ethylene response enough to keep an apple sellable for months.
segments.tr: تخزين التفاح التجاري في ولاية واشنطن يعمل في غرف **الغلاف الجوي المتحكم فيه** — انخفاض الأكسجين إلى ما يقرب من 1 إلى 3 بالمائة، وارتفاع ثاني أكسيد الكربون، ودرجة الحرارة أعلى بقليل من التجمد — مما يببط التنفس واستجابة الإيثيلين بما يكفي للحفاظ على التفاح قابلاً للبيع لأسابيع.

segments.src: That's how you buy a crisp Honeycrisp in June from an October harvest.
segments.tr: هكذا تشتري تفاح Honeycrisp مقرمشاً في يونيو من حصاد أكتوبر.

segments.src: Even your lawn is a hormone lesson.
segments.tr: حتى عشب حديقتك هو درس هرموني.

segments.src: Mowing decapitates the auxin-producing tips, apical dominance releases, and the grass responds by branching out from the base into new tillers.
segments.tr: الجزّ يزيل الأطراف المنتجة للأوكسين، وتطلق السيادة القمية، ويستجيب العشب بالتفرع من القاعدة إلى حرائث جديدة.

segments.src: Mowing doesn't just shorten grass — it makes it denser.
segments.tr: الجز لا يقتصر على تقصير العشب — بل يجعله أكثر كثافة.

segments.src: Same reason pinching back a basil plant on your windowsill gives you a bushy plant instead of a single leggy stem.
segments.tr: نفس السبب يجعل قرص نبات الريحان على نافذتك يمنحك نباتاً كثيفاً بدلاً من ساق طويلة فردية.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## ملخص من ثلاثة أسطر

segments.src: 1. Photosynthesis supplies the raw material for growth — plants build most of their mass from atmospheric CO2 and water, not from soil.
segments.tr: 1. يوفر التمثيل الضوئي المادة الخام للنمو — تبني النباتات معظم كتلتها من ثاني أكسيد الكربون والماء في الغلاف الجوي، وليس من التربة.

segments.src: 2. Development is directed by hormones (auxin, gibberellin, cytokinin, ABA, ethylene), and it's usually the ratio between them, not any single one, that determines the outcome.
segments.tr: 2. يتم توجيه التطور بواسطة الهرمونات (الأوكسين، الجبريلين، السيتوكينين، ABA، الإيثيلين)، وعادة ما تكون النسبة بينها، وليس أي منها وحدها، هي التي تحدد النتيجة.

segments.src: 3. Plant growth regulators let growers send those signals deliberately — to ripen fruit on schedule, shorten stems against lodging, size up produce, or kill weeds.
segments.tr: 3. تسمح منظمات نمو النبات للمزارعين بإرسال تلك الإشارات عمداً — لإنضاج الفاكهة في موعدها، وتقصير السيقان ضد الرقاد، وتكبير المنتجات، أو قتل الأعشاب الضارة.

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 مصطلحات اليوم

segments.src: - **Photosynthesis** — The process by which plants use light energy to convert carbon dioxide and water into sugar, releasing oxygen.
segments.tr: - **التمثيل الضوئي** — العملية التي تستخدم من خلالها النباتات طاقة الضوء لتحويل ثاني أكسيد الكربون والماء إلى سكر، مع إطلاق الأكسجين.

segments.src: - **Auxin** — A hormone that drives cell elongation and causes the growing tip to suppress the buds below it.
segments.tr: - **الأوكسين** — هرمون يدفع استطالة الخلايا ويجعل الطرف النامي يثبط البراعم أدناه.

segments.src: - **Apical dominance** — The suppression of side buds by the actively growing shoot tip, which produces a single-leader growth habit.
segments.tr: - **السيادة القمية** — قمع البراعم الجانبية بواسطة طرف الفرع النامي بنشاط، والذي ينتج عنه عادة نمو بقائد واحد.

segments.src: - **Ethylene** — A gaseous hormone that triggers fruit ripening and the shedding of leaves and fruit.
segments.tr: - **الإيثيلين** — هرمون غازي يحفز نضج الفاكهة وتساقط الأوراق والثمار.

segments.src: - **Plant growth regulator (PGR)** — A synthetic or extracted compound applied to crops to mimic or block a natural plant hormone.
segments.tr: - **منظم نمو النبات (PGR)** — مركب اصطناعي أو مستخلص يتم تطبيقه على المحاصيل لمحاكاة أو حظر هرمون نباتي طبيعي.

segments.src: - **Lodging** — The permanent collapse of a crop stem, usually from wind, rain, or a top-heavy seed head.
segments.tr: - **الرقاد** — الانهيار الدائم لساق المحصول، عادة بسبب الرياح أو الأمطار أو رأس البذور الثقيل.

segments.src: *Answers: 1-B (soil minerals matter enormously for plant health, but they're a small fraction of dry weight; the carbon backbone comes from atmospheric CO2 and the hydrogen from water).
segments.tr: *الإجابات: 1-B (معادن التربة مهمة للغاية لصحة النبات، لكنها تمثل نسبة صغيرة من الوزن الجاف؛ الهيكل الكربوني يأتي من ثاني أكسيد الكربون الجوي والهيدروجين من الماء).

segments.src: 2-C (the tip is the auxin factory; remove it and the lateral buds are freed to grow — the same mechanism that makes mowing thicken a lawn).
segments.tr: 2-C (القمة هي مصنع الأوكسين؛ قم بإزالتها وتتحرر البراعم الجانبية للنمو — نفس الآلية التي تجعل الجز كثيفاً).

segments.src: 3-O (ethylene is the one plant hormone that's a gas at room temperature, which is exactly what makes it practical to apply in a sealed ripening room).*
segments.tr: 3-صواب (الإيثيلين هو الهرمون النباتي الوحيد الذي يكون غازاً في درجة حرارة الغرفة، وهذا بالضبط ما يجعله عملياً للتطبيق في غرفة إنضاج محكمة).*

fr.title: [Agriculture 101 #7] Pourquoi votre pelouse pousse de côté après la tonte : la chimie de la croissance des plantes

segments.src: > Plants build their bodies from sunlight and air, then decide where to put that material using a handful of chemical signals — and farmers have learned to send those signals themselves.
segments.tr: > Les plantes fabriquent leur corps à partir de la lumière du soleil et de l'air, puis décident où placer ce matériau à l'aide d'une poignée de signaux chimiques — et les agriculteurs ont appris à envoyer eux-mêmes ces signaux.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Le concept du jour

segments.src: A corn plant standing seven feet tall in an Iowa field is made mostly of air and water.
segments.tr: Un plant de maïs haut de sept pieds dans un champ de l'Iowa est fait principalement d'air et d'eau.

segments.src: That sounds like a trick, but it's literal.
segments.tr: Cela ressemble à un tour de passe-passe, mais c'est littéral.

segments.src: Through **photosynthesis**, leaves pull carbon dioxide out of the atmosphere, split water pulled up from the roots, and use light energy to weld the pieces into sugar.
segments.tr: Grâce à la **photosynthèse**, les feuilles extraient le dioxyde de carbone de l'atmosphère, séparent l'eau puisée par les racines et utilisent l'énergie lumineuse pour souder les morceaux en sucre.

segments.src: The soil contributes minerals — nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium — but the bulk of the dry weight came in through tiny pores on the leaf surface called stomata.
segments.tr: Le sol apporte des minéraux — azote, phosphore, potassium — mais la majeure partie du poids sec est entrée par de minuscules pores sur la surface de la feuille appelés stomates.

segments.src: You can write the whole thing in one line:
segments.tr: Vous pouvez écrire tout cela en une seule ligne :

segments.src: 6 CO2 + 6 H2O + light energy -> C6H12O6 (sugar) + 6 O2
segments.tr: 6 CO2 + 6 H2O + light energy -> C6H12O6 (sugar) + 6 O2

segments.src: That's the **growth** half of the story: accumulating material.
segments.tr: C'est la moitié **croissance** de l'histoire : l'accumulation de matière.

segments.src: But a pile of sugar isn't a plant.
segments.tr: Mais un tas de sucre n'est pas une plante.

segments.src: The other half is **development** — deciding what to become and when.
segments.tr: L'autre moitié est le **développement** — décider quoi devenir et quand.

segments.src: A seedling has to choose whether to make more leaves or start a flower, whether to grow tall or grow thick, whether to hold its fruit or drop it.
segments.tr: Une plantule doit choisir si elle doit faire plus de feuilles ou commencer une fleur, si elle doit pousser en hauteur ou s'épaissir, si elle doit retenir son fruit ou le faire tomber.

segments.src: Those decisions are coordinated by **plant hormones**, chemical messengers made in tiny quantities that travel through the plant's tissues.
segments.tr: Ces décisions sont coordonnées par les **hormones végétales**, des messagers chimiques fabriqués en quantités minimes qui voyagent à travers les tissus de la plante.

segments.src: Five families do most of the work:
segments.tr: Cinq familles font l'essentiel du travail :

segments.src: - **Auxin** drives cell elongation and, critically, enforces *apical dominance* — the growing tip suppresses the buds below it, which is why an unpruned plant grows as a single leader.
segments.tr: - L'**auxine** stimule l'élongation cellulaire et, de manière critique, impose la *dominance apicale* — l'extrémité en croissance supprime les bourourgeons en dessous, c'est pourquoi une plante non taillée pousse comme un unique chef de file.

segments.src: - **Gibberellin** stretches stems and internodes, and triggers seed germination.
segments.tr: - La **gibbérelline** étire les tiges et les entrenœuds, et déclenche la germination des graines.

segments.src: - **Cytokinin** promotes cell division and pushes side buds to break out — essentially auxin's counterweight.
segments.tr: - La **cytokinine** favorise la division cellulaire et pousse les bourgeons latéraux à éclore — essentiellement le contrepoids de l'auxine.

segments.src: - **Abscisic acid (ABA)** is the stress brake. Under drought it closes stomata and enforces seed dormancy.
segments.tr: - L'**acide abscisique (ABA)** est le frein de stress. En cas de sécheresse, il ferme les stomates et impose la dormance des graines.

segments.src: - **Ethylene** is a gas, and it drives ripening and the shedding of leaves and fruit.
segments.tr: - L'**éthylène** est un gaz qui stimule la maturation et la chute des feuilles et des fruits.

segments.src: The important insight is that these hormones rarely act alone.
segments.tr: L'idée importante est que ces hormones agissent rarement seules.

segments.src: It's the *ratio* between them that matters.
segments.tr: C'est le *rapport* entre elles qui compte.

segments.src: High auxin relative to cytokinin favors roots; flip the ratio and you get shoots.
segments.tr: Une forte teneur en auxine par rapport à la cytokinine favorise les racines ; inversez le rapport et vous obtenez des pousses.

segments.src: Tissue culture labs exploit this directly: change the ratio in the growth medium and the same clump of cells becomes either a root mass or a leafy shoot.
segments.tr: Les laboratoires de culture tissulaire exploitent cela directement : changez le rapport dans le milieu de croissance et la même masse de cellules devient soit une masse racinaire, soit une pousse feuillue.

segments.src: Once researchers understood the signals, the next step was obvious — send them on purpose.
segments.tr: Une fois que les chercheurs ont compris les signaux, la prochaine étape était évidente — les envoyer exprès.

segments.src: **Plant growth regulators (PGRs)** are synthetic or extracted compounds that mimic or block natural hormones.
segments.tr: Les **régulateurs de croissance des plantes (PGR)** sont des composés synthétiques ou extraits qui immitent ou bloquent les hormones naturelles.

segments.src: Ethylene-releasing sprays ripen a tomato crop uniformly for machine harvest.
segments.tr: Des vaporisations libérant de l'éthylène font mûrir une récolte de tomates uniformément pour la récolte mécanique.

segments.src: Gibberellin applied to table grapes stretches the cluster so berries have room to swell.
segments.tr: La gibbérelline appliquée aux raisins de table étire la grappe pour que les baies aient de la place pour gonfler.

segments.src: Anti-gibberellins shorten wheat straw so the stalk doesn't fall over — lodging — under the weight of a heavy head.
segments.tr: Les anti-gibbérellines raccourcissent la paille de blé pour que la tige ne tombe pas — la verse — sous le poids d'un épi lourd.

segments.src: And the herbicide 2,4-D is essentially a synthetic auxin at a dose so high that broadleaf weeds grow themselves to death while grasses shrug it off.
segments.tr: Et l'herbicide 2,4-D est essentiellement une auxine synthétique à une dose si élevée que les mauvaises herbes à feuilles larges se développent jusqu'à en mourir tandis que les graminées haussent les épaules.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dans la vie quotidienne

segments.src: Walk into any American grocery store in February and look at the bananas.
segments.tr: Entrez dans n'importe quelle épicerie américaine en février et regardez les bananes.

segments.tr: Elles ont le bout vert et sont fermes — parce qu'elles ont été cueillies vertes au Guatemala ou en Équateur, expédiées dans des conteneurs réfrigérés, puis conservées dans une salle de mûrissement scellée où le distributeur injecte du gaz éthylène.

segments.src: A day or two later they come out yellow and ready for the shelf.

segments.src: The same chemistry is why the old advice about putting an unripe avocado in a paper bag with a banana actually works.
segments.tr: La même chimie explique pourquoi le vieux conseil de mettre un avocat pas mûr dans un sac en papier avec une banane fonctionne réellement.

segments.src: Ripening fruit emits ethylene; the bag traps it; the avocado's own ripening enzymes get switched on early.

segments.src: It's a two-dollar version of a commercial ripening room.

segments.src: And the reverse trick shows up in your produce drawer.

segments.src: Apples are heavy ethylene emitters, which is why storing them next to lettuce or broccoli makes those greens yellow and go limp faster than they should.
segments.tr: Les pommes sont de grands émetteurs d'éthylène, c'est pourquoi les stocker à côté de la laitue ou du brocoli fait jaunir ces légumes verts et les ramollit plus vite que prévu.

segments.src: Commercial apple storage in Washington State runs on **controlled atmosphere** rooms — oxygen dropped to roughly 1 to 3 percent, carbon dioxide raised, temperature just above freezing — which slows respiration and ethylene response enough to keep an apple sellable for months.
segments.tr: Le stockage commercial des pommes dans l'État de Washington fonctionne dans des pièces à **atmosphère contrôlée** — oxygène abaissé à environ 1 à 3 pour cent, dioxyde de carbone augmenté, température juste au-dessus du point de congélation — ce qui ralentit la respiration et la réponse à l'éthylène juste assez pour garder une pomme vendable pendant des mois.

segments.src: That's how you buy a crisp Honeycrisp in June from an October harvest.
segments.tr: C'est ainsi que vous achetez une Honeycrisp croustillante en juin à partir d'une récolte d'octobre.

segments.src: Even your lawn is a hormone lesson.

segments.src: Mowing decapitates the auxin-producing tips, apical dominance releases, and the grass responds by branching out from the base into new tillers.
segments.tr: La tonte décapite les pointes productrices d'auxine, la dominance apicale se relâche et l'herbe réagit en se ramifiant à partir de la base en de nouvelles talles.

segments.src: Mowing doesn't just shorten grass — it makes it denser.
segments.tr: La tonte ne fait pas que raccourcir l'herbe, elle la rend plus dense.

segments.src: Same reason pinching back a basil plant on your windowsill gives you a bushy plant instead of a single leggy stem.
segments.tr: C'est la même raison pour laquelle pincer un plant de basilic sur votre rebord de fenêtre vous donne une plante touffue au lieu d'une seule tige grêle.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## Résumé en trois lignes

segments.src: 1. Photosynthesis supplies the raw material for growth — plants build most of their mass from atmospheric CO2 and water, not from soil.

segments.src: 2. Development is directed by hormones (auxin, gibberellin, cytokinin, ABA, ethylene), and it's usually the ratio between them, not any single one, that determines the outcome.

segments.src: 3. Plant growth regulators let growers send those signals deliberately — to ripen fruit on schedule, shorten stems against lodging, size up produce, or kill weeds.

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Termes du jour

segments.src: - **Photosynthesis** — The process by which plants use light energy to convert carbon dioxide and water into sugar, releasing oxygen.
segments.tr: - **Photosynthèse** — Le processus par lequel les plantes utilisent l'énergie lumineuse pour convertir le dioxyde de carbone et l'eau en sucre, en libérant de l'oxygène.

segments.src: - **Auxin** — A hormone that drives cell elongation and causes the growing tip to suppress the buds below it.
segments.tr: - **Auxine** — Une hormone qui stimule l'élongation cellulaire et fait en sorte que l'extrémité en croissance supprime les bourgeons en dessous.

segments.src: - **Apical dominance** — The suppression of side buds by the actively growing shoot tip, which produces a single-leader growth habit.
segments.tr: - **Dominance apicale** — La suppression des bourgeons latéraux par l'extrémité de la pousse en croissance active, ce qui produit un port de croissance à tige unique.

segments.src: - **Ethylene** — A gaseous hormone that triggers fruit ripening and the shedding of leaves and fruit.
segments.tr: - **Éthylène** — Une hormone gazeuse qui déclenche la maturation des fruits et la chute des feuilles et des fruits.

segments.src: - **Plant growth regulator (PGR)** — A synthetic or extracted compound applied to crops to mimic or block a natural plant hormone.
segments.tr: - **Régulateur de croissance des plantes (PGR)** — Un composé synthétique ou extrait appliqué aux cultures pour imiter ou bloquer une hormone végétale naturelle.

segments.src: - **Lodging** — The permanent collapse of a crop stem, usually from wind, rain, or a top-heavy seed head.
segments.tr: - **Verse** — L'effondrement permanent d'une tige de culture, généralement causé par le vent, la pluie ou un épi lourd.

segments.src: *Answers: 1-B (soil minerals matter enormously for plant health, but they're a small fraction of dry weight; the carbon backbone comes from atmospheric CO2 and the hydrogen from water).
segments.tr: *Réponses : 1-B (les minéraux du sol comptent énormément pour la santé des plantes, mais ils ne représentent qu'une petite fraction du poids sec ; le squelette carboné provient du CO2 atmosphérique et l'hydrogène de l'eau).

segments.src: 2-C (the tip is the auxin factory; remove it and the lateral buds are freed to grow — the same mechanism that makes mowing thicken a lawn).
segments.tr: 2-C (l'extrémité est l'usine à auxine ; retirez-la et les bourgeons latéraux sont libérés pour croître — le même mécanisme qui fait que la tonte épaissit une pelouse).

segments.src: 3-O (ethylene is the one plant hormone that's a gas at room temperature, which is exactly what makes it practical to apply in a sealed ripening room).*
segments.tr: 3-V (l'éthylène est la seule hormone végétale qui soit un gaz à température ambiante, ce qui est exactement ce qui le rend pratique à appliquer dans une salle de mûrissement scellée).*

pt.title: [Agriculture 101 #7] Por Que Seu Gramado Cresce de Lado Depois Que Você O Corta: A Química do Crescimento Vegetal

segments.src: > Plants build their bodies from sunlight and air, then decide where to put that material using a handful of chemical signals — and farmers have learned to send those signals themselves.
segments.tr: > As plantas constroem seus corpos a partir da luz solar e do ar, e então decidem onde colocar esse material usando um punhado de sinais químicos — e os agricultores aprenderam a enviar esses sinais eles mesmos.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## O Conceito de Hoje

segments.src: A corn plant standing seven feet tall in an Iowa field is made mostly of air and water.
segments.tr: Uma planta de milho com dois metros de altura em um campo de Iowa é feita principalmente de ar e água.

segments.src: That sounds like a trick, but it's literal.
segments.tr: Isso parece truque, mas é literal.

segments.src: Through **photosynthesis**, leaves pull carbon dioxide out of the atmosphere, split water pulled up from the roots, and use light energy to weld the pieces into sugar.
segments.tr: Por meio da **photosynthesis**, as folhas retiram dióxido de carbono da atmosfera, dividem a água puxada das raízes e usam a energia da luz para soldar as peças em açúcar.

segments.src: The soil contributes minerals — nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium — but the bulk of the dry weight came in through tiny pores on the leaf surface called stomata.
segments.tr: O solo contribui com minerais — nitrogênio, fósforo, potássio —, mas a maior parte do peso seco entrou por diminutos poros na superfície da folha chamados estômatos.

segments.src: You can write the whole thing in one line:
segments.tr: Você pode resumir tudo em uma linha:

segments.src: 6 CO2 + 6 H2O + light energy -> C6H12O6 (sugar) + 6 O2
segments.tr: 6 CO2 + 6 H2O + light energy -> C6H12O6 (sugar) + 6 O2

segments.src: That's the **growth** half of the story: accumulating material.
segments.tr: Essa é a metade do **growth** da história: acumular material.

segments.src: But a pile of sugar isn't a plant.
segments.tr: Mas uma pilha de açúcar não é uma planta.

segments.src: The other half is **development** — deciding what to become and when.
segments.tr: A outra metade é o **development** — decidir o que se tornar e quando.

segments.src: A seedling has to choose whether to make more leaves or start a flower, whether to grow tall or grow thick, whether to hold its fruit or drop it.
segments.tr: Uma muda tem que escolher se faz mais folhas ou começa uma flor, se cresce alta ou grossa, se segura seu fruto ou o deixa cair.

segments.src: Those decisions are coordinated by **plant hormones**, chemical messengers made in tiny quantities that travel through the plant's tissues.
segments.tr: Essas decisões são coordenadas por **plant hormones**, mensageiros químicos feitos em quantidades minúsculas que viajam pelos tecidos da planta.

segments.src: Five families do most of the work:
segments.tr: Cinco famílias fazem a maior parte do trabalho:

segments.src: - **Auxin** drives cell elongation and, critically, enforces *apical dominance* — the growing tip suppresses the buds below it, which is why an unpruned plant grows as a single leader.
segments.tr: - **Auxin** impulsiona o alongamento celular e, de forma crítica, reforça a *dominância apical* — a ponta em crescimento suprime os brotos abaixo dela, razão pela cual uma planta não podada cresce como uma única haste principal.

segments.src: - **Gibberellin** stretches stems and internodes, and triggers seed germination.
segments.tr: - **Gibberellin** estica caules e entrenós, e desencadeia a germinação de sementes.

segments.src: - **Cytokinin** promotes cell division and pushes side buds to break out — essentially auxin's counterweight.
segments.tr: - **Cytokinin** promove a divisão celular e empurra os brotos laterais para romperem — essencialmente o contrapeso da auxina.

segments.src: - **Abscisic acid (ABA)** is the stress brake. Under drought it closes stomata and enforces seed dormancy.
segments.tr: - **Abscisic acid (ABA)** é o freio de estresse. Sob seca, fecha os estômatos e impõe a dormência das sementes.

segments.src: - **Ethylene** is a gas, and it drives ripening and the shedding of leaves and fruit.
segments.tr: - **Ethylene** é um gás que impulsiona o amadurecimento e a queda de folhas e frutos.

segments.src: The important insight is that these hormones rarely act alone.
segments.tr: O insight importante é que esses hormônios raramente agem sozinhos.

segments.src: It's the *ratio* between them that matters.
segments.tr: É a *razão* entre eles que importa.

segments.src: High auxin relative to cytokinin favors roots; flip the ratio and you get shoots.
segments.tr: Muita auxina em relação à citocinina favorece raízes; inverta a proporção e você obtém brotos.

segments.src: Tissue culture labs exploit this directly: change the ratio in the growth medium and the same clump of cells becomes either a root mass or a leafy shoot.
segments.tr: Laboratórios de cultura de tecidos exploram isso diretamente: alteram a proporção no meio de crescimento e o mesmo aglomerado de células se torna uma massa de raízes ou um broto folhoso.

segments.src: Once researchers understood the signals, the next step was obvious — send them on purpose.
segments.tr: Uma vez que os pesquisadores entenderam os sinais, o próximo passo era óbvio — enviá-los de propósito.

segments.src: **Plant growth regulators (PGRs)** are synthetic or extracted compounds that mimic or block natural hormones.
segments.tr: **Plant growth regulators (PGRs)** são compostos sintéticos ou extraídos que imitam ou bloqueiam hormônios naturais.

segments.src: Ethylene-releasing sprays ripen a tomato crop uniformly for machine harvest.
segments.tr: Sprays liberadores de etileno amadurecem uma safra de tomates uniformemente para colheita mecânica.

segments.src: Gibberellin applied to table grapes stretches the cluster so berries have room to swell.
segments.tr: Giberelina aplicada a uvas de mesa estica o cacho para que as bagas tenham espaço para inchar.

segments.src: Anti-gibberellins shorten wheat straw so the stalk doesn't fall over — lodging — under the weight of a heavy head.
segments.tr: Anti-giberelinas encurtam a palha do trigo para que o colmo não tombe — acamamento — sob o peso de uma espiga pesada.

segments.src: And the herbicide 2,4-D is essentially a synthetic auxin at a dose so high that broadleaf weeds grow themselves to death while grasses shrug it off.
segments.tr: E o herbicida 2,4-D é essencialmente uma auxina sintética em dose tão alta que ervas daninhas de folhas largas crescem até a morte enquanto as gramíneas dão de ombros.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Na Vida Quotidiana

segments.src: Walk into any American grocery store in February and look at the bananas.
segments.tr: Entre em qualquer supermercado americano em fevereiro e olhe para as bananas.

segments.src: They're green-tipped and firm — because they were picked green in Guatemala or Ecuador, shipped in refrigerated containers, and then held in a sealed ripening room where the distributor pumps in ethylene gas.
segments.tr: Elas estão com pontas verdes e firmes — porque foram colhidas verdes na Guatemala ou no Equador, enviadas em contêineres refrigerados e depois mantidas em uma sala de amadurecimento selada onde o distribuidor injeta gás etileno.

segments.src: A day or two later they come out yellow and ready for the shelf.
segments.tr: Um dia ou dois depois, elas saem amarelas e prontas para a prateleira.

segments.src: The fruit ripens on a schedule the retailer sets, not the tree.
segments.tr: O fruto amadurece em um cronograma que o varejista define, não a árvore.

segments.src: The same chemistry is why the old advice about putting an unripe avocado in a paper bag with a banana actually works.
segments.tr: A mesma química é a razão pela qual o velho conselho sobre colocar um abacate verde em um saco de papel com uma banana realmente funciona.

segments.src: Ripening fruit emits ethylene; the bag traps it; the avocado's own ripening enzymes get switched on early.
segments.tr: Frutas amadurecendo emitem etileno; o saco o retém; as enzimas de amadurecimento do próprio abacate são acionadas mais cedo.

segments.src: It's a two-dollar version of a commercial ripening room.
segments.tr: É uma versão de dois dólares de uma sala de amadurecimento comercial.

segments.src: And the reverse trick shows up in your produce drawer.
segments.tr: E o truque inverso aparece na sua gaveta de produtos frescos.

segments.src: Apples are heavy ethylene emitters, which is why storing them next to lettuce or broccoli makes those greens yellow and go limp faster than they should.
segments.tr: As maçãs são fortes emissoras de etileno, e é por isso armazena-las ao lado de alface ou brócolis faz com que esses vegetais fiquem amarelos e murchos mais rápido do que deveriam.

segments.src: Commercial apple storage in Washington State runs on **controlled atmosphere** rooms — oxygen dropped to roughly 1 to 3 percent, carbon dioxide raised, temperature just above freezing — which slows respiration and ethylene response enough to keep an apple sellable for months.
segments.tr: O armazenamento comercial de maçãs no estado de Washington funciona em salas de **controlled atmosphere** — oxigênio reduzido para cerca de 1 a 3 por cento, dióxido de carbono aumentado, temperatura logo acima do congelamento — o que desacelera a respiração e a resposta ao etileno o suficiente para manter uma maçã vendável por meses.

segments.src: That's how you buy a crisp Honeycrisp in June from an October harvest.
segments.tr: É assim que você compra uma Honeycrisp crocante em junho de uma colheita de outubro.

segments.src: Even your lawn is a hormone lesson.
segments.tr: Até seu gramado é uma lição de hormônios.

segments.src: Mowing decapitates the auxin-producing tips, apical dominance releases, and the grass responds by branching out from the base into new tillers.
segments.tr: Cortar a grama decapita as pontas produtoras de auxina, a dominância apical é liberada e a grama responde ramificando-se a partir da base em novos perfilhos.

segments.src: Mowing doesn't just shorten grass — it makes it denser.
segments.tr: Cortar não apenas encurta a grama — torna-a mais densa.

segments.src: Same reason pinching back a basil plant on your windowsill gives you a bushy plant instead of a single leggy stem.
segments.tr: Mesma razão pela qual podar uma planta de manjericão no seu parapeito de janela lhe dá uma planta arbustiva em vez de uma única haste esguia.

segments.tr: ## Resumo de Três Linhas

segments.tr: 1. A fotossíntese fornece a matéria-prima para o crescimento — as plantas constroem a maior parte de sua massa a partir de CO2 atmosférico e água, não do solo.
